records.title: FOREVER: Forgetting Curve-Inspired Memory Replay for Language Model Continual Learning
records.reason: FOREVER studies memory replay for continual language-model learning; its contribution is training data/schedule efficiency, not inference.

records.title: SteerVLM: Robust Model Control through Lightweight Activation Steering for Vision Language Models
records.reason: SteerVLM uses lightweight activation steering to control VLM output behavior; the abstract reports robustness/control, not inference-performance benefits.

records.title: Memo: Training Memory-Efficient Embodied Agents with Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Memo targets memory-efficient training of embodied agents with reinforcement learning; it is outside LLM inference/serving.

records.title: The Automated LLM Speedrunning Benchmark: Reproducing NanoGPT Improvements
records.reason: The work benchmarks AI-agent reproduction of prior LLM speedrunning results; it evaluates research reproducibility rather than proposing a deployable inference/serving improvement.

records.title: Think Twice, Act Once: A Co-Evolution Framework of LLM and RL for Large-Scale Decision Making
records.reason: The co-evolution framework targets large-scale decision-making via LLM and RL; the abstract addresses task capabilities and learning, not inference efficiency.
